question: Which of the following is the riverine port in India that has also been a witness to India's struggle for independence, World Wars l and II and socio-cultural changes taking place in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Syama Prasad Mookerjee Trust**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Syama Prasad Mookerjee Trust:
 
 
• This port was **established** in **1870** and was put under the administration of Port Commissioners, which later became Port Trust.
 
• This was also the** first port** under **British rule**.
 
• It is the **oldest operating port** in India and was constructed by the **British East India Company**.
 
• **Kolkata Port** kept on handling nearly half of **India’s trade**.
 
• Kolkata Port, officially known as **Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Trust **is the only riverine major port of India, located in the **city of Kolkata**, West Bengal.
 
• Kolkata is a freshwater port with no variation in salinity.
 
• It is also known as **Diamond Harbour** and known for **twin dock** systems viz. **Kolkata Dock on the eastern bank** and **Haldia Dock on the western bank** of river Hooghly.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important Port Trust of India:

 
 
• Paradip Port Trust: Odisha
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust: Maharashtra
 
• Visakhapatnam Port Trust: Andhra Pradesh
 
• Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Trust: West Bengal
 
• V. O. Chidambaranar Port Trust: Tamil Nadu
 
• Mormugao Port Trust: Goa
